en: Krishna said: I taught this lasting yoga to Vivasvan, the sun. Vivasvan taught it to Manu, and Manu taught it to Ikshvaku.
Handed down in this way from one to the next, the royal sages knew it. But over a long time, destroyer of foes, this yoga was lost to the world.

first: स एवायं मया तेऽद्य योगः प्रोक्तः पुरातनः ।
en: That same ancient yoga I have told you today, because you are my devotee and my friend. It is a great secret.

first: अपरं भवतो जन्म परं जन्म विवस्वतः ।
en: Arjuna said: Your birth was later, and Vivasvan's birth was earlier. How am I to understand that you taught it in the beginning?

first: बहूनि मे व्यतीतानि जन्मानि तव चार्जुन ।
en: Krishna said: Arjuna, many births of mine have passed, and of yours too. I know them all, but you do not know them, destroyer of foes.
Though I am unborn and my self does not change, and though I am the Lord of all beings, I take birth through my own power, resting on my own nature.

first: यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत ।
en: Whenever dharma declines and wrong rises, Bharata, I bring myself into being.
To protect the good, to destroy those who do evil, and to set dharma firmly in place, I come into being age after age.

first: जन्म कर्म च मे दिव्यमेवं यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः ।
en: One who truly knows my divine birth and work in this way is not born again after leaving the body, but comes to me, Arjuna.
Free from craving, fear and anger, absorbed in me and taking refuge in me, many people, made pure by the discipline of knowledge, have reached my state.

first: ये यथा मां प्रपद्यन्ते तांस्तथैव भजाम्यहम् ।
en: In whatever way people come to me, in that same way I respond to them. Son of Pritha, people follow my path in every way.

first: काङ्क्षन्तः कर्मणां सिद्धिं यजन्त इह देवताः ।
en: Those who want success in their actions worship the gods here, because in the human world success from action comes quickly.
I created the four classes according to the division of qualities and work. Though I made them, know me to be the one who does not act and does not change.

first: न मां कर्माणि लिम्पन्ति न मे कर्मफले स्पृहा ।
en: Actions do not stain me, and I have no desire for their results. One who knows me in this way is not bound by actions.

first: एवं ज्ञात्वा कृतं कर्म पूर्वैरपि मुमुक्षुभिः ।
en: Knowing this, people seeking freedom acted in the past too. So you also should act, as those before you acted long ago.
What is action? What is inaction? Even the wise are confused about this. So I will tell you what action is, and knowing it you will be freed from harm.

first: कर्मणो ह्यपि बोद्धव्यं बोद्धव्यं च विकर्मणः ।
en: One must understand action, one must understand wrong action, and one must understand inaction. The way of action is hard to grasp.

first: कर्मण्यकर्म यः पश्येदकर्मणि च कर्म यः ।
en: One who sees inaction in action and action in inaction is wise among people. Such a person is steady in yoga and does all work.
One whose every undertaking is free from desire and selfish plans, and whose actions are burned up in the fire of knowledge, is called wise by those who know.
Giving up attachment to the results of action, always content and depending on nothing, such a person does nothing at all, even while fully engaged in action.
Without hope, with mind and self under control, giving up all wish to own things, and doing action only with the body, such a person earns no sin.
Content with whatever comes by itself, beyond the pairs of opposites, free from envy, and the same in success and failure, such a person is not bound even when acting.
For one who is free from attachment, freed, with a mind fixed in knowledge, and who acts only as sacrifice, all action melts away.
The offering is Brahman, the oblation is Brahman, poured by Brahman into the fire that is Brahman. One who sees Brahman in all action goes to Brahman.
Some yogis offer sacrifice to the gods. Others offer sacrifice as sacrifice into the fire of Brahman.
Some offer hearing and the other senses into the fires of self-control. Others offer sound and the other sense objects into the fires of the senses.
Others offer all the actions of the senses and of the life-breath into the fire of the yoga of self-control, lit by knowledge.
Some offer wealth as sacrifice, some austerity, some yoga practice. Others, disciplined and firm in their vows, offer study and knowledge as sacrifice.
Some offer the in-breath into the out-breath and the out-breath into the in-breath. Stopping the flow of both, they devote themselves to breath control.
Others, controlling their food, offer the life-breaths into the life-breaths. All of these know sacrifice, and their sins are destroyed by sacrifice.
Those who eat the nectar left from sacrifice reach the eternal Brahman. Best of the Kurus, this world is not for one who does not sacrifice, so how could another world be?

first: एवं बहुविधा यज्ञा वितता ब्रह्मणो मुखे ।
en: In this way many kinds of sacrifice are spread out before Brahman. Know that all of them are born of action. Knowing this, you will be freed.
Destroyer of foes, the sacrifice of knowledge is better than the sacrifice of things. All action, son of Pritha, ends completely in knowledge.
Learn it by bowing down, by asking questions, and by serving. The wise who have seen the truth will teach you knowledge.
Knowing it, Pandava, you will not fall into such confusion again. By it you will see all beings in yourself, and then in me.
Even if you were the worst of all sinners, you would cross over all wrong with the boat of knowledge alone.
Arjuna, just as a blazing fire turns firewood to ashes, the fire of knowledge turns all actions to ashes.

first: न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते ।
en: There is nothing in this world as purifying as knowledge. One who is perfected in yoga finds it in oneself in time.
A person with faith, devoted to it and in control of the senses, gains knowledge. Having gained knowledge, one soon reaches supreme peace.
The ignorant, the faithless and the doubting are lost. For the doubter there is neither this world nor the next, nor any happiness.
Actions do not bind one who has given up action through yoga, whose doubts are cut away by knowledge, and who is master of oneself, Dhananjaya.
So, with the sword of knowledge, cut away this doubt in your heart born of ignorance. Take up yoga and stand up, Bharata.
